key_concepts: The mole is the SI unit for amount of substance
One mole contains Avogadro's number of particles, 6.02 x 10^23
Representative particles are atoms for elements, molecules for molecular compounds and dia
Molar mass is the mass in grams of one mole of a substance
Molar mass is calculated by summing atomic masses from the periodic table
Mass and moles are interconverted using molar mass
Number of particles and moles are interconverted using Avogadro's number
Worked examples show mole-mass-particle calculations for substances such as ascorbic acid,
Mole concept has daily life applications such as medicine and environmental monitoring
